Theme

Latin word

quārē

quārē (quā rē)

adverb (relative connection)

and so, for this reason (leading to a request or advice); why? for what reason?

In this lexicon

  • therefore

    also used · classical · Cic. Fam. 1.10.1: quā rē fac ut quam prīmum veniās; Quint. 1.4.12: quārē discat puer, quid in litterīs proprium, quid commūne

  • why

    also used · classical · Catull. 85.1: quārē id faciam, fortasse requīris; Mart. 1.32.1: nec possum dīcere quārē; Traupman 407

Examples

  • ōdī et amō. quārē id faciam, fortasse requīris. nesciō, sed fierī sentiō et excrucior

    I hate and I love. Why do I do it, perhaps you ask. I don’t know, but I feel it happening, and I am in tormentCatull. 85.1–2
